summary: GatewaySettings source order is init, environment, pydantic dotenv, PolicyYamlSource, then file secrets. Field defaults apply when no source sets a value. PolicyYamlSource flattens config YAML. The usual .env path is load_dotenv_once(override=False) before GatewaySettings() is constructed, so those values arrive as process environment. REALMM_CONFIG selects the YAML file; the default path is config/realmm.yaml. Runtime layer toggles are a JSON overlay, not a rewrite of the YAML.

nodes.role: pydantic-settings model. env_file is None. extra ignore.

Sections: rate_limits, reliability, memory, pii, guards, budget.
FLAG_NAMES MEMORY, PII, GUARD, GUARD_INJECTION, GUARD_CONTENT. Does not mutate os.environ.
Identity store path passed by bootstrap.
Process env wins over dotenv. YAML applies until env overrides. Secrets stay out of repr. Provider keys remain in environ. Allow-open defaults off. Embedder is validated.

notes: flatten_policy copies rate_limits.default_rpm and default_tpm, reliability.retries/cache/cache_ttl/fallbacks, memory.enabled/llm_model/embedder/embedding_dims, pii.enabled/spacy_model/entities, guards.enabled/injection/content/injection_model/content_model/content_ignore, and budget max_output_tokens, max_input_tokens, daily_token_budget, daily_usd_budget.
Provider RPM and TPM: YAML providers table, then DEFAULT_RPM/DEFAULT_TPM env, then {PROVIDER}_RPM and {PROVIDER}_TPM env.
Auth-related settings seen on the model: gateway_api_key, gateway_multi_key default 1, gateway_key_pepper, gateway_allow_open default 0, gateway_allow_split_budget default 0.
Memory embedder default in MemoryRuntime is fastembed. openai has built-in dims. Other names need memory.embedding_dims. NVIDIA embed ids are a separate built-in path.
RESTART_FOR is keys, redis, budgets, MEMORY_EMBEDDER, PII_ENTITIES. PATCH /config only applies the five layer flags.

Compose overrides REDIS_URL, workers, GATEWAY_ALLOW_OPEN, CORS_ORIGINS, CONSOLE_URL, and Hugging Face / FastEmbed cache paths under /app/data/cache. The data directory is a bind mount, not baked into the image.
On-disk key and budget JSON contents were not opened. Paths come from bootstrap call sites.
